control_arb_bm25.description: ARB's own BM25 baseline (arb eval-baseline --ranker bm25 --candidate-filter all_files), rerun on the same machine

protocol.denominator: all selected samples; errors contribute zero
protocol.mrr_ranking: full supplied file ranking; see per-case ranking_depth
protocol.split: dev when the first byte of sha256(sample_id) is even

scope: All 345 positive samples; community result, not a leaderboard entry
